model_annotation: The figure presents two line plots comparing the training rewards of two methods—Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY—across different training sets. The top plot, labeled "Easy Training Set," shows training rewards on the y-axis ranging from 0.0 to 0.4, plotted against the number of steps on the x-axis, which spans from 0 to 500. The Llama-On-Policy-Easy method (teal line) starts at a training reward of approximately 0.01 and steadily increases, reaching a final reward of about 0.38. The Llama-LUFFY-Easy method (red line) begins at a similar point, around 0.01, and also rises, ultimately achieving a training reward of approximately 0.41. Both lines exhibit fluctuations, but the Llama-LUFFY-Easy line generally maintains a higher reward throughout the training process. The bottom plot, labeled "Hard Training Set," displays training rewards on the y-axis from 0.0 to 0.2, with the x-axis also ranging from 0 to 500. The Llama-On-Policy-Hard method (teal line) starts at a training reward of about 0.02, increases rapidly to a peak of approximately 0.12 around 100 steps, and then remains relatively flat, ending at a reward of about 0.01. In contrast, the Llama-LUFFY-Hard method (red line) starts at a training reward of about 0.01, increases to a peak of approximately 0.15 around 100 steps, and then fluctuates, ending at a reward of about 0.21. The Llama-LUFFY-Hard method consistently achieves higher training rewards than the Llama-On-Policy-Hard method across the entire training period.
